terrain.current: Actual baked relief is visible, but subdued olive land and lower spatial detail look flatter and coarser than the reference. Gold relief lighting is absent.
terrain.reference: Neutral land is varied green/brown; country fill still shows some real texture. Fine coast and golden edges separate land/water.
terrain.requiredImprovement: Licensed source relief contrast, restrained locally supported warm highlights. Do not invent elevation or claim satellite/3D data parity.

ocean.current: Dark teal water has broad low-contrast variation but appears flat at contact-sheet scale; little nearshore/deep-water separation.
ocean.reference: A broader coastal/deep-water tonal gradient supports the peninsula silhouette. The design concept has richer surface lighting than either video.
ocean.requiredImprovement: Controlled coastal/deep color transition and subtle coherent surface texture; retain original shoreline and avoid noisy animation.

territoryFrontier.current: North orange/red is readable. Bright gained purple forms a separate flat saturated band above the older muted purple, making one faction read as two different materials. Advancing boundary is visible from color alone but lacks a local light cue.
territoryFrontier.reference: Irregular northward advance is coherent, with earlier western gain and later eastern reach. Reference also differentiates gained/existing purple; current new instruction explicitly favors a consistent single winning-faction style.
territoryFrontier.requiredImprovement: Same winning-faction material behind the real unchanged boundary, terrain visible beneath fill, thin local glow exactly tied to current evaluated controls.

camera.current: Camera tracks the northward advance with gradual pan/zoom/roll. No contact-sheet-visible hard cut or discontinuous motion appears in all150 displayed frames.
camera.reference: Terrain and unit cluster move coherently as the map tracks and rotates. Full direct footage matching remains approximate due to geography/registration differences.
camera.requiredImprovement: Retain measured saved camera rather than add a new camera performance.

units.current: Eight flag/helmet badges visibly borrow the recognizable badge/flag vocabulary of the source. Their full-size supporting outlines compete with the actual frontier.
units.reference: Eight symbols persist (three northern, five southern); no explosion, plane, nuclear icon or smoke is present in this selected interval.
units.requiredImprovement: Original restrained full-body/faction unit silhouettes over the same geographic anchors; no copied national icon artwork or speculative combat effects.
